description: This file contains unit tests for the RetrieveAclEntryStrategy class, which is part of the Eclipse Ditto project's persistence actors related to ACL (Access Control List) retrieval strategies. The tests verify immutability, error handling when ACL entries are missing, and successful retrieval of existing ACL entries.

classes.name: RetrieveAclEntryStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveAclEntryStrategy, testing immutability, error handling, and successful ACL retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RetrieveAclEntryStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that RetrieveAclEntryStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: retrieveAclEntryFromThingWithoutAcl
methods.description: Tests retrieval attempt from a Thing without an ACL, expecting an exception.

methods.name: retrieveAclEntryFromThingWithoutThatAclEntry
methods.description: Tests retrieval attempt for a non-existing ACL entry on a Thing, expecting an exception.

methods.name: retrieveExistingAclEntry
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of an existing ACL entry.
